summary: Fort Technology Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 13, 2026, reporting its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements and Management's Discussion and Analysis for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report under Rule 13a-16, containing no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change. The financial statements show a net loss of $1.3 million for the six-month period and include note of the company formerly being Impact Acquisitions Corp., but no transformational corporate action is disclosed. This is a standard regulatory filing, not a special situation, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
